questions.stem: A box plot has Q1=6 and Q3=14. What is the upper outlier fence?
questions.explanation: Upper fence equals Q3 plus 1.5 times IQR. IQR is 8, so 14 + 12 = 26. Values beyond 26 are flagged as outliers.
